en.question: How long do I have to complain about a faulty product in Sweden?
en.answer: You must complain within a reasonable time after you noticed the fault, and a complaint within two months is always in time. The seller answers for faults that show up within three years of delivery.
en.how: After the three years you have two more months to make the claim. Tell the seller what is wrong and keep a copy, for example an email. The right to complain applies even when the product has no guarantee.

en.question: Who must prove the fault if a product breaks within two years?
en.answer: A fault that shows up within two years of delivery is presumed to have existed when you received the product. The seller must then show that it did not, for example that you damaged it.
en.how: After two years you must show that the fault was there from the start. The presumption does not apply if it cannot fit the nature of the product or the fault.

en.question: Can I get my money back for a faulty product?
en.answer: First you may ask for repair or a replacement. If that is not possible, takes too long or fails, you may ask for a price reduction or cancel the purchase and get your money back.
en.how: You may also claim damages for costs the fault caused you. You may not cancel the purchase if the seller shows that the fault is minor.

en.question: What is the difference between a guarantee and the right to complain?
en.answer: The right to complain comes from the law and applies to every purchase from a business, for three years. A guarantee is an extra promise from the seller or maker and can never reduce your rights under the law.
en.how: When the guarantee has run out you can still complain under the law. Under a guarantee the seller must show that the fault is not covered.

en.question: Can I return something I bought online in Sweden?
en.answer: Yes. For most online purchases you have a 14 day right of withdrawal, counted from the day you received the goods. You do not need to give a reason.
en.how: If the seller never told you about the right, the period is extended by up to one year. Exceptions include goods made to order, perishable goods and opened sealed hygiene products.

sv.how: Har säljaren inte informerat om ångerrätten förlängs tiden med upp till ett år. Undantag gäller bland annat specialtillverkade varor, färskvaror och öppnade förseglade hygienvaror.

en.answer: The seller must pay back what you paid, including the standard delivery cost, no later than 14 days after learning of your withdrawal. The seller may wait until the goods are returned or you show they have been sent.
en.how: You normally pay the return postage if you were told so beforehand. If you handled the goods more than needed to examine them, the seller may deduct for the loss in value.

en.question: What can I do if the shop refuses my complaint?
en.answer: You can take the dispute to the National Board for Consumer Disputes (ARN) free of charge. ARN gives a recommendation, which most businesses follow, but it is not binding.
en.how: Complain to the business in writing first and keep the answer. Hallå konsument gives free guidance before you file, and a court remains open if the business does not follow ARN.

en.question: What is the notice period for a rented flat in Sweden?
en.answer: For a flat let until further notice, the notice period is three months, counted to the turn of a month. That applies both when you and when the landlord gives notice.
en.how: Notice should be given in writing. A longer period may be agreed in the lease, but a shorter one cannot be imposed on you as tenant.

en.answer: The landlord must keep the flat in a usable condition during the lease. If it is not, you may get a rent reduction for the time the fault lasts, and you may ask the Rent Tribunal to order repairs.
en.how: Report the fault to the landlord in writing as soon as you notice it. Do not hold back the rent on your own, since late rent can cost you the lease.

en.answer: If the rent is more than a week late, the landlord may terminate the lease. You can usually keep the flat if you pay within three weeks of being notified of the termination.
en.how: The landlord must also inform the social services. The chance to recover the lease does not apply if you have repeatedly paid late.

en.question: What rules apply if I rent out my own flat or house?
en.answer: Private people letting their own home use a separate act. The rent may cover your capital and running costs, and for a lease until further notice the tenant may give one month's notice and you must give three months' notice.
en.how: The tenant has no right to stay on after notice, and the act applies when you do not let homes as a business. A condominium owner still needs the housing association's consent to let the flat.

sv.question: Vilka regler gäller om jag hyr ut min egen bostad?
sv.answer: Privatpersoner som hyr ut sin egen bostad följer en särskild lag. Hyran får täcka dina kapital- och driftskostnader, och vid hyra tills vidare har hyresgästen en månads uppsägningstid och du tre månader.
sv.how: Hyresgästen har inget besittningsskydd, och lagen gäller när du inte hyr ut bostäder som näring. En bostadsrättshavare behöver ändå föreningens samtycke för att hyra ut.

no.question: Hvilke regler gjelder hvis jeg leier ut min egen bolig i Sverige?
no.answer: Privatpersoner som leier ut sin egen bolig, følger en egen lov. Leien kan dekke kapital- og driftskostnadene dine, og ved leie på ubestemt tid har leietakeren én måneds oppsigelsestid og du tre måneder.
no.how: Leietakeren har ikke rett til forlengelse, og loven gjelder når du ikke leier ut boliger som næring. En borettshaver trenger likevel foreningens samtykke for å leie ut.

en.question: How long is my notice period if my employer dismisses me?
en.answer: The notice period is at least one month. It grows with your time at the employer: two months after two years, three after four, four after six, five after eight and six months after ten years.
en.how: When you resign yourself, the statutory notice period is one month. A collective agreement may set other periods.

sv.question: Hur lång uppsägningstid har jag om arbetsgivaren säger upp mig?
sv.answer: Uppsägningstiden är minst en månad. Den ökar med anställningstiden: två månader efter två år, tre efter fyra, fyra efter sex, fem efter åtta och sex månader efter tio år.
sv.how: Säger du själv upp dig är lagens uppsägningstid en månad. Ett kollektivavtal kan ange andra tider.

en.question: Can my employer dismiss me without a reason?
en.answer: No. A dismissal by the employer must be based on objective grounds, either a lack of work or reasons relating to you personally. Personal reasons are not enough if the employer could reasonably have moved you to other work.
en.how: Since October 2022 the act speaks of objective reasons, and the assessment of personal reasons focuses more on how you have acted. A trial period can be ended without such grounds.

sv.question: Får arbetsgivaren säga upp mig utan skäl?
sv.answer: Nej. En uppsägning från arbetsgivaren ska vara sakligt grundad, antingen på arbetsbrist eller på skäl som hänför sig till dig personligen. Personliga skäl räcker inte om arbetsgivaren skäligen kunnat omplacera dig.

en.question: How long can a trial period last and how is it ended?
en.answer: A trial period may last at most six months. Unless otherwise agreed, either side may end it before it runs out without giving a reason, and the employer must give at least two weeks' notice that it will end.
en.how: If neither side ends it, the trial period turns into a permanent job. A collective agreement may set other rules.

sv.answer: En provanställning får vara högst sex månader. Om inget annat avtalats kan båda parter avsluta den innan tiden gått ut utan att ange skäl, och arbetsgivaren ska lämna besked minst två veckor innan den upphör.

no.answer: En prøveansettelse kan vare høyst seks måneder. Med mindre annet er avtalt, kan begge parter avslutte den før tiden er ute uten å oppgi grunn, og arbeidsgiveren skal gi beskjed minst to uker før den opphører.
no.how: Avslutter ingen den, går prøveansettelsen over til fast ansettelse. En tariffavtale kan ha andre regler.

en.question: Who has to go first when there is a lack of work?
en.answer: The employer follows an order of priority based on time in employment, last in first out, within each operating unit. Before that, the employer may exempt three employees it considers most important.
en.how: You must have sufficient qualifications for the remaining work to keep your place. A collective agreement may set a different order.

en.question: Do I have a right to be rehired after a redundancy?
en.answer: Yes, if you have been employed for more than twelve months in total during the last three years. The right lasts from the notice until nine months after your employment ended.
en.how: You must tell the employer that you want to use the right. It applies to the same operating unit, and you must have sufficient qualifications for the new job.

sv.answer: Ja, om du har varit anställd i sammanlagt mer än tolv månader under de senaste tre åren. Rätten gäller från uppsägningen till nio månader efter att anställningen upphört.

en.question: How do I challenge a dismissal I think is wrong?
en.answer: You must notify the employer that you want the dismissal declared invalid no later than two weeks after you were dismissed. The dismissal must be in writing and explain how to challenge it; if it does not, the limit is one month from when the employment ended.
en.how: If you are a union member, contact the union first. Since October 2022 the employment ends when the notice period runs out, even while the dispute continues.

en.question: How many days of holiday do I have, and what happens when I leave?
en.answer: Every employee in Sweden has a right to 25 days of annual leave a year. Holiday pay you have earned but not taken is paid out as holiday compensation when the employment ends.
en.how: Holiday is earned during one year and taken the next, unless the employer uses another model. A collective agreement may give more days, never fewer.

sv.answer: Alla anställda i Sverige har rätt till 25 semesterdagar om året. Semesterlön som du tjänat in men inte tagit ut betalas som semesterersättning när anställningen upphör.

no.answer: Alle ansatte i Sverige har rett til 25 feriedager i året. Feriepenger du har opptjent, men ikke tatt ut, betales som feriegodtgjørelse når ansettelsen opphører.
